rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with compact ICM, somewhat looser TE, intact zona, and no major degeneration; appropriately notes the Gardner stage nuance between 3 and 4. Minor limitation is some image-specific features are inferred rather than strictly verifiable from the static image.

Integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian response, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, smoking, and prior IVF failures with embryo quality and prognosis. Could be stronger by addressing missing AMH more explicitly and more tightly linking repeated failures to differential causes.

Overall logical and internally consistent: good embryo and favorable age offset by smoking and recurrent failure history, leading to a moderated implantation estimate. Minor issue is some speculative discussion (fresh vs frozen, progesterone elevation, hydrosalpinx) without direct case evidence.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading, single embryo transfer in a 34-year-old, cavity/tubal reassessment after repeated failures, and cautious stance on PGT-A. Slight deviations include speculative ancillary testing and some less standard suggestions not clearly indicated by the provided data.

Provides practical next steps: proceed with single embryo transfer, optimize luteal support per protocol, smoking cessation, reassess cavity, confirm hydrosalpinx treatment, and review prior cycle details. Useful and case-directed, though some recommendations remain somewhat broad rather than protocol-specific.
